title: Add a page that lists one Project's Plans
purpose: The dashboard has pages for individual Plans, but the address for a Project's list of Plans returns not found. This Plan adds that page, so the operator can open a Project and see its Plans.
serves: Its milestone, a working Plan list for each Project on the dashboard, which supports the aim that the operator can see the portfolio without holding it in mind.
done_when: Opening a Project's Plans page lists its Plans, an unknown name shows the existing error message instead of crashing, and the Plans index links each Project to its page.
reading_note: Draft: an inactive draft. Its one Action is open.

actions.title: Show one Project's Plans on its own dashboard page
actions.why: Plan pages exist, but the Project-level address has no page, so it returns not found.
actions.done_when: Opening the page for a known Project lists its Plans, an unknown name shows the existing error state, the Plans index links to each Project's page, and a dashboard test checks both cases.
